Popoak is a dead tuskarr located in Brackenhide Brambles in the Azure Span. As a great hunter, he went with his fellow tuskarr to a hunt, but was killed by the Brackenhide gnolls. When the adventurer found his body and called upon his spirit, instead of crossing over Popoak resolved to empower Brena's Totem to fight against the decay-corrupted gnolls. Brena then summoned him to help destroy the Twisted Ancient, after which Brena thanked him and released all the spirits to be with Karkut.

Power Matrices are glowing "mote[s] of titanic power" that spawn on the upper platforms of the Festering Core during the G'huun encounter in Uldir. Players need to pick them up and carry them across the Amorphous Cyst-covered platforms to deposit them in the Reorigination Drive, generating enough energy to trigger Reorigination Blasts on G'huun and his minions.

Powers are temporary, run-specific enhancements granted to players during certain instanced or event-driven content. They were first introduced as Anima powers in Torghast, Tower of the Damned with the expansion. Over time, the system was expanded to other content types, including Mythic+ (via a seasonal affix), Delves, and events like Awakening the Machine while retaining the same underlying structure.

The Preyseeker's Journey is a seasonal rewards track for the Prey system, found in the Journeys tab of the Adventure Guide, during Midnight Season 1. Preyseeker's Journey progress is granted by completing a Prey quest. For every 4,000 Preyseeker's Journey progress, a new reward is unlocked. There are 10 total unlocks per season—mostly cosmetics and other items that can be purchased from Construct V'anore (mounts, pets, transmog) or Construct Ali'a (housing decor) in Astalor's Sanctum in Silvermoon City. For the Midnight Season 2 rewards track, see Preyhunter's Journey instead.

Through Beledar, she discovered a way to raise the dead using the power of the Sacred Flame, intending to build an army to conquer Khaz Algar. Queensguard Zirix is a nerubian spiderlord commanding the nerubian forces on the Isle of Dorn, and the main antagonist of the Isle of Dorn storyline. Zirix personally ambushes and battles Magni Bronzebeard until the arrival of Stormward Baelgrim and the Stormriders forces him to retreat underground, but at the same time he sends his forces to Dornogal to destroy the Coreway. It has been experienced by people all across Azeroth, reporting it as a vision "filled with light and benevolence", "warm", "comforting", "like coming home". The Reorigination Drive is a re-origination device located in the Festering Core of Uldir. During the G'huun encounter, players need to carry Power Matrices across the Amorphous Cyst-covered upper platforms of the room and deposit them in one of the two Reorigination Drive interfaces lodged in the wall, generating energy for the device. Upon reaching 100 energy the drive releases Reorigination Blast, temporarily stunning and increasing damage taken by G'huun and his minions, and ultimately forcing him to dislodge from the wall in which he is encased. The Revantusk Sedge was the home of the Revantusk tribe, who lived in Zul'Aman. As his granddaughter Lilaju rose to the position of chieftain and led her people away, the Twilight's Blade desecrated the area as they seized it as their own. Lilaju later asked the hash'ura to infiltrate the Revantusk Sedge and recover the body of Idago, who had sacrificed himself to ensure her survival when the village was destroyed by the Twilight's Blade.
